messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: lavaan 0.5-18 needs testing!
parts:
Dear lavaan users,

I have rolled up a 'release candidate' for lavaan 0.5-18. To install
this version, type in R:

install.packages("lavaan", repos="http://www.da.ugent.be", type="source")

and it should be version 0.5-18.822 (or higher).

Can you give it a try and check if it doesn't break anything? If all
goes well, I hope to upload this version to CRAN by the end of the week.

These are the more important changes:

- a new way to handle linear equality constraints, see
http://lavaan.ugent.be/notes/lavaan_eq_constraints.pdf
- new function lavPredict() to compute factor scores
- many lav_matrix_* functions are now public
- modindices() has many filter options, including sort = TRUE
- estimator = "PML" now has a goodness-of-fit test statistic (PLRT)
- many new options for the lavTech/lavInspect/inspect functions

Most important bug fix:

- standard errors for standardized parameters (in the output of
standardizedSolution()) are now correct

Yves.

Dear Yves,

If this information may help or if my model specification misguided you; in the model, in addition to the categorical variables specified in the ordered function, I had two other latent variables but not specified in the ordered (). I was curious if this may change the warning message and the there was no warning when I remove these variables (continuous variable not specified in the ordered function). The other latent variables that are not specified in the ordered() are 5 point scales that I didn't specify them in the order() because I want to treat them like continuous variable. I specified only the items that are ordinal (3 point scale). I will consider if you have any suggestions regarding the modeling of continuous variables. Do I need to specify the continuous variables in the ordered () ? Because I was thinking that the parameterization is theta and these items are not specified as ordered and this may be making the trouble.

Ashenafi
